name: Gearbox
text: Switch to **Cerebras CS-3** for EXCAVA’s heavy lifting. It’s the only chip that crunches LLMs at full speed without bottlenecks, and the 70B model just ate a 400B token dataset in half the time of a cluster of A100s. Trade-off: you lose the flexibility of swapping models on the fly, but you gain 0.7% faster inference—enough to tip the scale.

name: Torque
text: Cerebras CS-3 locks you into a single architecture—no fallback if the model drifts or the chip fails. A cluster of H100s with vLLM gives you swap-ability and 0.3% lower peak throughput, but keeps you alive if Cerebras’ software stack implodes. Run a 48-hour bake-off: same prompt batch, measure tokens/sec and failover time—winner decides.
